title:
A $40,000
brand kit in
three prompts.

prompts.heading: The brand guide.
prompts.sub: Start with your two visual inspirations.
prompts.text: I'm building a personal brand. My aesthetic is inspired by [your two inspirations]. I want dark, moody, minimal. Colors should feel like ink on cream paper with blood red accents. Build me a complete brand guide with color palette, typography, spacing and visual rules.
prompts.tip: Drag your screenshots right into the chat.

prompts.heading: Fifty templates.
prompts.sub: A library you can pull from each time you create.
prompts.text: Using my brand guide, create 50 social media post templates that I can use on LinkedIn and Instagram. Include quote cards, carousel covers, image posts with text overlays and announcement templates. Export them so I can edit in Canva. Each template should only use my brand colors and my brand fonts. Follow the spacing rules from my guide.

prompts.heading: The website.
prompts.sub: Your web presence matches your social presence.
prompts.text: Using my brand guide, build me a personal website landing page. It should have a hero section with my name and tagline, a section explaining what I do, a section with testimonials, and a call to action to book a call. Keep it minimal, dark background. The design should feel like walking into a curated gallery. Not a templated website.
prompts.tip: Drag in a screenshot of a website you admire.

close.line:
Your taste
is the input.
AI just makes it real.
close.cta: Save this for your next rebrand
